description.value: A one-directional line etched into the world. The first time a creature crosses it each encounter, it takes 2d6 damage per rank of this spell and can't cross back over that same line for the rest of the encounter.

cinderfall.incomplete: The persistent one-way barrier that blocks re-crossing for the rest of the encounter is a placed zone/hazard restriction, not an actor-level rule element -- would need a scene-level wall/hazard object, entirely outside system.rules scope. The damage-on-crossing half needs no rule element (PAT-DMG, lives in system.damage) and is not a gap.
